name: skillsmith
description: Craft and upkeep of skills. Authoring reference (the vocabulary and principles that make any agent-consumed document predictable — a skill, an AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, a rules file, a doc reached by a pointer) plus provenance tracking for borrowed work: compares an adapted skill to its pinned upstream, flags behavioral drift and fabricated attributions, and refreshes the reviewed commit SHA. Houses writing-for-agents and upstream-review.

interface.longDescription: Authoring reference for writing predictable agent-facing documents (skills, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, rules files), plus provenance tracking that compares an adapted skill to its pinned upstream and flags behavioral drift or fabricated attributions.
defaultPrompt: Review this adapted skill against its upstream source.
